games.title: Blind Crown — Nightfall
games.description: Private-plan medieval archery for 2–10 seats. Four tactical diorama worlds teach corner lanes, arrow-permeable hedges, single-bank ice and announced shutters. Silent live bots, finite four-arena Tour, seeded stage replay and exact completed-round reviews; four Canvas cameras and Classic/Precision privacy retained.

source.provenance: Tactical Worlds v1.7 over archived supplied Refined v1.4. Active engine/perspective/artwork extended for explicit materials and shared segmented shot geometry. Original archive, room client, Three bridge and embedded model preserved. Kenney CC0 particle sprite actually used in Canvas impacts, embedded for offline fallback. Current standalone SHA-256: 81ecc8b18e4e65ce17513d19746d4513023530dec0ee3e9eac614f8256d8c515. See tests/worlds-verification.json and assets/worlds-provenance.json. Experimental Three backend remains unverified.

games.title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
games.description: Radial ball-deflection survival for 2–10 contestants. Four physical courts: Beach Siege, wind-driven Gale Harbour, Moonwell vortex and Clockwork Keep deflectors. Silent all-bot title exhibition, 75-second four-court Tour, classic Siege and 60-second Defense Drill; saved grouped rules/style/controls/access preferences, licensed local effects, map-aware bots. Camera/CAM and public seat hooks retained. Phone/network transport is not integrated.

source.provenance: Based on edmondsonedits/CALLBACK commit ed09d25b690b36b397516e4d77437e3dd21247c8 (game-modes/royal-ballistix/index.html), with CALLBACK Arcade improvements and the 0.14.0 Worlds revision. Upstream Apache-2.0 and Kenney CC0 asset licenses retained locally. Current standalone SHA-256: bfb1502a133a0200adc2c4df9478c5dcdca1592d2f72ca3664aca663a6b2161d. See tests/evidence/worlds-checks.json and docs/quality/worlds-2026-10-12/task-1-report.md for evidence and limitations.

games.title: Royal Roller Ruckus — Crownway Circuit
games.description: A 2–10 racer momentum cage race across Crownway, Frostglass, Foundry and Skygarden, with live bot title races, warned hazards, course practice, a four-course Series, seeded replay, scoped records and extensive player/access preferences.

source.provenance: Imported user-supplied original preserved unchanged. Active v1.6.0 adds four courses, isolated live bot title, practice/Series, seeded replay, customization and licensed local Kenney scenery. Existing Three r180 engine and classic physics retained. Official matching MIT GLTFLoader/utilities use local import paths only; no runtime CDN.

games.title: Royal Scratch Match
games.description: Four Courts Tour: standalone call-and-response rhythm for 2–10 contestants, with a silent live bot title with directly accessible Watch/Start, swing/offbeat/mirror stages, exact-phrase rehearsal, aggregate Tour, performer customization and timing/access tools. One local player plus bots by default; phone multiplayer is not integrated.

source.provenance: Original v0.5 standalone supplied by user, unchanged in source/archive. Editable Canvas runtime v0.7.0 Four Courts Tour. Local CC0 Kenney particles/impact sound and MIT Alea provenance in source/assets/provenance.json; source-bound regression evidence in tests/worlds-evidence.json.

games.title: Royal Sumo — Crownfall
games.description: Royal Sumo: Crownfall v1.3.0: a 2–10 fighter physics brawler with six arenas, Quick Match/Crown Cup, one or two local players and bots. Self-contained WebGL2 build. Phone-room controls and server implemented; public relay deployment pending.

local: WASD / Space or J / Shift or K or L
second player: arrows / Enter / Right Shift or period or Numpad0
gamepad stick / A or X / B or Y or RB or RT

The former v0.21 CALLBACK entry and its MIT-licensed Three.js dependency are archived together.

games.title: Royal Twisted — Four Towers
games.description: Four 2–10 contestant survival towers: classic jump/duck cadence, Ember vent-to-burst patterns, Frost duck-to-recover grip, and warned Storm gust bracing. Includes silent live bots, finite skill practice and four-stage Tour, captured-rule seeded replay and scoped records.

source.provenance: Imported v0.5 original and v0.4 archive remain unchanged. Active v0.7.0 retains locally bundled Three.js r180, adds local MIT GLTF loader and CC0 Kenney Castle Kit scenery with texture closure and hashes. See tests/evidence/worlds.json and source/assets/provenance.json.

games.title: Space Bash — Four Decks
games.description: A 2–10 contestant Canvas orbital brawler with four skill decks, real CPU title demos, crown matches, finite four-deck Series, map practice, seeded replay and persistent style, rules and access controls.
